source_title: Filmmaker Sanjay Gupta passes away at 57
source_excerpt: Sanjay Gupta, the filmmaker known for his crime dramas, urban thrillers and stylised action films, has reportedly passed away. Working as a director, screenwriter and producer, he left a lasting imprint on mainstream Hindi cinema. No cause of death has been shared yet, and the industry is waiting for further word from his family and close associates.How Sanjay Gupta began his directorial career with âAatishâGuptaâs journey as a director began with 'Aatish: Feel the Fire' in 1994, an action drama headlined by Sanjay Dutt and Aditya Pancholi. The film gave audiences their first look at his taste for hard-hitting action, punchy dialogues and stylised storytelling. In the years that followed, he developed a visual style all his own, especially in films set in the world of crime and the Mumbai underworld.Kamaal Khan pays tribute to Sanjay GuptaTaking to X handle, Kamaal Khan confirm the sad news and wrote, "RIP Sanjay Bhai.
